title: Move Discount Taken off the Level Moved To, Keyturn Guest Protection Plan
content:
A move discount is taken off the cost of the level moved to on a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election. The
move discount is the move discount rate of that cost, expressed as a percentage of it. Which rate applies turns
on how much of the cover is still to run and on how long the trip is reserved for on the Keyturn Trip Booking.

1. Where half or more of the election's covered days are still to run — a share of 0.5 or more, that is 50
   percent or more of them — and the trip's reserved period runs for 1 or more whole months, 12.0 percent is
   taken off.
2. Where half or more of the election's covered days are still to run and the trip's reserved period runs for
   fewer than 1 whole month, 6.0 percent is taken off.
3. Where fewer than half of the election's covered days are still to run, nothing is taken off and the rate
   stands at 0.

## The combinations in full

| Share of the covered days still to run | Whole months the reserved period runs for | Rate taken off |
|---|---|---|
| 0.5 or more | 1 or more | 12.0 percent |
| 0.5 or more | Fewer than 1 | 6.0 percent |
| Under 0.5 | 1 or more | 0 |
| Under 0.5 | Fewer than 1 | 0 |

The share is met at the half itself: an election carrying 20 covered days with exactly 10 still to run stands
at a share of 0.5 and takes one of the two rates above; with 9 still to run it takes none.

## Worked on hypothetical moves

A cost of 500.00 USD for the level moved to, on an election carrying 40 covered days with 24 still to run and a
reserved period of one whole month, has 12.0 percent of 500.00 USD taken off, which is 60.00 USD, leaving
440.00 USD. The same cost on an election carrying 12 covered days with 8 still to run, reserved for a fortnight,
has 6.0 percent taken off, which is 30.00 USD, leaving 470.00 USD. The same cost on an election carrying 40
covered days with 8 still to run has nothing taken off.
